description: Cruise Ports in Jamaica is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). "This points shapefile represents the location of the cruise ports in Jamaica and intensity of visitation. This dataset was created on 24th April 2003 and represents all cruise ports in the Wider Caribbean and the number of calls by cruise ships that are scheduled between 1st May 2003 and 1st May 2004. Coverage: Jamaica. It has 1 file in SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
